notes.title: Patch Note 9: Version 2.0.14
notes.notes:
Hi everyone !

A new patch is available for Windows, Mac & Linux versions.

It updates the japanese localization and fix 2 mistyping in english (thanks to Hanuo!).
And if no preference has been set for the "Controls Display", the game will detect if a controller is connected at launch. If there is no controller, the value will be set to "keyboard".

notes.title: Patch Note 7: Version 2.0.10
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,


We have a new patch note for Windows, Mac and Linux. 


- Fix some musics that were not playing at the right moment

- Fix collision in the level « Crystal Hollow »

- Add a visual at the end of the fight against the last boss to have a better understanding of what the player have to do.

 - Fix a bug where it was impossible to switch aegis after exiting a level while switching aegis

- Fix an infinite fall in the level «  Faith’s Promenade »

- Fix the Timako FX

notes.title: Patch note 4 : Time Trial unlocked
notes.notes:
Hey, new patch note for Windows, Mac and Linux, and moreover the arrival of the Time trial version. 


New Feature

-          Time Trial mode unlocked at the end of episode 1:


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25373241/45bdd4f65e4c0599cf37d07407eced8eb848d552.png 

Fight your ghost (which is a lovely Mudjin)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25373241/0bc9868d2e120bbacfafa2ffd3f87a2855c615a4.jpg



And add you name in the online leader board

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25373241/b82c6b1d4a9f88255953f86ff624ca55905c682c.png



Here are all the other modifications,

 
Bug fixes :

-          Enemies sometimes fell from platforms in underground levels

-          Sounds were not always positioned correctly in underground levels

-          Gelatyn spawned from Gelato were invulnerable if killed with the Inyan nebula of Ardour aegis.

-          Some locked Mytholiths were visible

-          Fix on the Royal Gelato that could be killed during the second phase instead ot the third with Suwata Nebula : http://steamcommunity.com/app/418670/discussions/0/340412628171685800/
 
Misc. :

-          Spell check on English & French dialog

-          Bow with Inyan nebula make less damages 

-          Some dialog & cut scenes already seen were played even if the level was finished

-          The Mytholiths unlocked outside Steam are unlocked when launching the game in Steam

-          The language specified in Steam game properties is used as default language in the game

-          Some levels have been modified to work with the time trial mode

-          Mudjins already caught are now visible when playing a level already finished

-          Pause menu optimized





If you encounter any other problems you can post it in the hub community. 

Thank you again for sharing, we are really happy to improve our little Pankapu thanks to you! 

Let's start the fight for the online leader board!! 


All the Too Kind Studio Team

notes.title: Patch note 3 : Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey, new patch note for Windows, Mac and Linux. 


Here are the modifications:


Pause Menu :

-          Display buttons to switch pages

-          Switch page animation accelerated

-          Mudjins counter on map is now hidden if the Mio’s Shard has not been found

-           Special attacks control in aegis description are now hidden if they are not unlocked

 
Localization :

-          Chinese logo added

 
Controls :
-          PS controls display : the DPad down icon was not the good one

 
Misc. :

-          Automatically equip the first nebula

-          Open Pause Menu on the Mytholith details when the first mytholith is unlocked

-          Spikes barely visible have been removed

-          Some dialogs where played again even if the player already saw them



If you encounter any other problems you can post it in the hub community. 

Thank you again for sharing, we are really happy to improve our little Pankapu thanks to you! 


All the Too Kind Studio Team

notes.title: Patch note 1 : Bug fixes + Russian localization
notes.notes:
Hey, the first patch note was just released for Windows, Mac and Linux. 


Here are the last modifications: 


Localization: 

-          Russian localization added

Interface: 

-          Selected resolution is now saved

-          Controller & Keyboard configs are now saved

Bug fixes:

-          Dialog fix : sometimes the text was skipped twice

-          Collision fix on specific edges

-          Oä & Omnia mytholith / success is now unlockable

-          Fixed a bug where bow target was staying visible

Optimization:  

-          King Gelato level optimized for low configurations 
-          Change in the level Tanglewood: the first sequence after the             Zoldabilly has been arranged in order to help players to understand the synergy between Champilums and Bumpers.


If you encounter any other problems you can post it in the hub community. 

Thank you for sharing, we are really happy to improve our little Pankapu thanks to you! 


All the Too Kind Studio Team
